summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Defense to notify TRICARE beneficiaries electronically at specific intervals (one year, 180 days, and 30 days) before they are required to make changes to their TRICARE enrollment to continue coverage, and to conduct an outreach campaign about these requirements.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends Title 10 of the U.S. Code, which pertains to the armed forces, specifically addressing TRICARE, the healthcare program for military personnel and their families. While it doesn't directly increase or decrease military spending, it mandates new notification and outreach requirements for TRICARE beneficiaries, which would incur administrative costs for the Department of Defense. This is a minor increase in the scope of military-related operations and associated costs.
